subject: Re: Renewal roadmap — channel invoice alignment for Aperture Health
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation & billing alignment options

Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Aperture's renewal is coming up in November and you mentioned wanting to consolidate billing through your cloud channel rather than direct invoice. We can absolutely support that (AWS Marketplace or Azure Marketplace), and have a few practical paths depending on timeline and procurement needs.

Short note on options:
- Fast path (no pricing change): Amend current SOW to allow marketplace invoicing and map existing SKUs to marketplace SKUs. Ideal if procurement can accept an amendment and marketplace terms.
- Co-sell path (preferred for accounts using marketplace credits): Move whole subscription to marketplace listing — this requires a short entitlement mapping and a DocuSign amendment.
- Delayed cutover: Renew direct for 12 months while we run a parallel marketplace entitlement for future expansion.

Ask: can you share who in procurement needs the legal/commercial amendment (name + email)? Also, any constraints around PO vs. marketplace purchase orders? I’ve attached a draft SKU mapping to show how current line items would map to marketplace SKUs.

Attached: aperture-procurement-questionnaire.pdf (procurement Qs), amendment-marketplace-sku-map.xlsx

If you prefer I can loop in our channel lead (Grace) to coordinate the marketplace onboarding checklist.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aperturehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aperture Health Procurement <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation & billing alignment options

Alex —

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement here is handled by me and Sara Patel (procurement@aperturehealth.com). A few constraints we have:
- We need an amendment that shows total spend parity (marketplace <= current price) or a credit schedule documented.
- Our finance team requires a marketplace invoice line that maps to our internal GL codes; please provide the SKU mapping spreadsheet in CSV as well.
- PE firm oversight — we need an audit trail and ability to produce invoices for the board.

Questions:
1) If we move to marketplace, will our historical usage/billing remain tied to the existing contract for audit?
2) Any lead time required to get marketplace listing active so we can close renewal by 11/15?

We can sign a DocuSign amendment once the SKU map and legal redline are ready. Also, can you confirm whether marketplace billing triggers any change to SLA or data residency terms?

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Procurement, Aperture Health
Tom.Reynolds@aperturehealth.com | +1 650-555-0119

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aperture renewal — marketplace discount / SKU mapping

Grace / Logan —

Quick internal note following Tom's reply (below). Procurement wants parity or credit language; timeline is tight — they need to close by 2025-11-15.

Proposed approach:
- Offer a one-time marketplace credit of 8% to offset any friction moving to marketplace billing (applied as partner credit at first invoice). If finance pushes back, we can escalate to 10% but want leadership OK.
- I attached the SKU mapping; Logan can you convert to CSV and include GL code column?
- Grace — can you own the marketplace activation checklist and confirm lead time for AWS vs Azure? My read: AWS listing activation + entitlement can be done in ~2 weeks if we have the amendment and reseller mapping; Azure may need a bit longer.

Also, I think we should attach a short commercial summary to the DocuSign packet that calls out the credit and confirms no changes to SLA/data residency.

Thanks — Alex

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Sep 2025 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding & DocuSign for Aperture Health renewal

Tom —

Appreciate the clarity on procurement. I own channel onboarding and have confirmed the following:

1) Lead time: AWS marketplace entitlement + seller mapping typically 7–10 business days once we submit the amendment and SKU map. Azure is ~10–14 business days for entitlement.
2) SLA & data residency: No change — the marketplace purchase is an invoicing path only; contractual SLA and data residency commitments remain under the amended agreement.
3) Commercial: Redwood is prepared to provide a one-time 9% marketplace credit applied to the first marketplace invoice to ensure dollar-for-dollar parity.

Action items I’ve attached: draft-amendment.pdf (redline ready for your legal), amendment-marketplace-sku-map.xlsx (final SKU mapping). I also uploaded a DocuSign envelope for the amendment: https://www.docusign.net/recipient/status?envelopeId=abc-123-aptr (please use the procurement alias to sign).

If procurement signs this week we can complete the AWS cutover by 10/10 which gives your team time to validate invoices before renewal.

Thanks — Grace O'Connor
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment: draft-amendment.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: amendment-marketplace-sku-map.xlsx (XLSX)]

Grace / Alex —

Good to see the amendments and thanks for moving quickly. Procurement has reviewed the redline and the marketplace credit (9%) looks acceptable to our CFO. We signed the DocuSign envelope from the procurement alias (procurement@aperturehealth.com) this afternoon.

Next asks from Finance:
- Please send the first marketplace invoice to finance@aperturehealth.com and include the GL code column mapped in the SKU CSV.
- Can you confirm the exact date the marketplace invoice will be issued after activation? Our board wants clear timeline for recognition.

We’re targeting the renewal effective date of 2025-11-01. Thanks for the smooth coordination — please CC me on the final invoice routing.

—Tom
